description: Benchmark reference dataset for ship resistance validation. Sources: Roddy 1990 (SUBOFF), ITTC V&V Workshop (DTMB-5415), SIMMAN 2008 (KVLCC2). | v1.1: froude_number recomputed from geometry, experimental_rt_n derived or withheld, reference density declared, unusable cases tagged data_status=withheld (audit: tools/verifier/audit_benchmark_reference.py)

findings: v1.0 experimental_rt_n violated Rt=0.5*rho*V^2*S*Ct for 12/12 cases (implied wetted surface 0.10-0.30 of the geometry-implied value)
v1.0 froude_number for DTMB-5415 was consistent with L~181 m, not the stated L=5.72 m - speed column is full-scale while geometry is model-scale
v1.0 did not declare the water density, so Ct<->Rt conversion was ambiguous
the accuracy gate compared Ct only, so the broken Rt column never surfaced in the 15% verdict but was published verbatim by /calculations/benchmark_cases

cases.data_status_reason: declared speed 2.572 m/s gives Fn=0.343 on the stated length L=5.72 m, but v1.0 published Fn=0.061 which implies L=181.2 m instead (sanity bound Fn<=1.0) - the speed column and the geometry appear to come from different scales, case cannot be scored against the model geometry
cases.rt_derivation: v1.0 published an Rt that violated Rt=0.5*rho*V^2*S*Ct by a factor of 4-10; the wetted surface is not part of this case, so Rt cannot be reconstructed without inventing data - withheld instead
